cleanup: No degenerate gaussians found. Recentred on its own bounding box (a 1.5% shift), which is what a generic viewer orbits about. The generator put this one's up axis along Y, matching the dataset, so no rotation was needed this time.
caveats: Regenerated 2026-08-03 from a different photograph. The first attempt used a long-lens frame of the upper shaft only, so it came out as a sphere and an antenna on a stub; this input carries the whole tower, and the tapering shaft is now in the data at its true proportion.
The very foot of the tower is below the bottom of the input frame, so the object ends at the shaft rather than at the ground.
